project.title: Microbiome in hospital sink drain surfaces
project.description: Samples were collected from the surfaces of sink drains in twelve rooms before and after cleaning. The extracted DNAs were used to amplify V3-V4 region of 16S rRNA gene, and were sequenced using the MiSeq 300x2 nt paired-end platform.
project.center_name: R&D - Safety Science Research, Kao Corporation
